description: Version 1.18, gripper only (builds on 1.17, related: voice-cfdf2d31): Correction to 1.17: the fingers SHOULD taper in thickness toward the tip like the Generalist reference gripper does. But keep one face flat so it's easy to 3D print: the taper goes down from one side only (a flat bottom with the top sloping down toward the tip), not a symmetric taper toward the midplane. Reference images: cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_closed.png and references/generalist.

results.identified_issue: New folder Two Finger Gripper/versions/v018_generalist_flat_taper copied from v017. gripper.scad: flat_taper() is a Y-Z polygon intersected with the plate extrusion; ventral -Y face untouched (polygon extends 1 mm past it to avoid coplanar faces), dorsal +Y face follows thick(f)=plate-(plate-tip_thick)f^2 from dot_z (82.1) to tip[1] (124.3) — Gen 16 r2's half_thick parabola but one-sided. tip_thick 2.4 reused from Gen 16 r2 (Jake asked for a thicker tip then); no rounded nub at the point in side view (Gen 16 had one) — the end face is the plan-view point. Chose -Y (ventral, digit side) as the flat face arbitrarily; mirroring is a sign flip. Dropped lug/slide per AGENTS.md '1.x = gripper only' even though 1.17 had them (1.17 predates the convention); if Jake wanted them kept, re-add from v017. check_geometry thickness() replaced with flat_bottom_and_one_sided_taper; slide checks removed; genus drops the slide. Scripts/check_gripper_closure.py FAILs for every Generalist gen (pre-existing), and v018 is 'not in the published catalog' until publish runs. Gallery label is 18 (int, like 17) in publish_designs.py.
results.summary: Made version 1.18: the fingers taper again toward the tip, but only from the top, so the bottom stays flat for printing.
results.detailed_description:
1.18 is 1.17's fingers with the thickness tapering again past the black dot, like the Generalist. The finger stays 12 mm thick up to the dot. From there the top face slopes down on the same curve Gen 16 used and reaches 2.4 mm at the point. The bottom face stays one flat plane from base to point, so each finger prints lying on it with no supports.

Because 1.x is gripper only, I left out 1.17's lug and strap slide. Everything else is unchanged: the outline, holes, grooves and the tip-only contact. All the geometry checks pass, including a new one that confirms the bottom is flat at every station.

The edge-on preview shows the profile best. Two things to judge: whether 2.4 mm is the right tip thickness, and whether the slope starts at the right point. Right now it starts at the black dot. Versions 2.1 and 2.2 still use 1.17's untapered fingers.

summary: The gripper fingers in version 1.18 should taper in thickness toward the tip like the Generalist reference gripper, correcting 1.17. Keep a flat bottom for easy 3D printing, with only the top sloping down toward the tip rather than a symmetric taper.
